paper.title: Sparse Attention Mechanisms for Representation Learning

questions.text: How does sparse attention maintain representation capacity with linear compute?

claims.statement: Sparse factorized attention matches dense transformer perplexity with 4x memory reduction.
claims.observation: Figure 1 displays validation perplexity curves overlapping dense baselines across 100k steps.
claims.author_interpretation: Authors claim factorization preserves all critical attention routing paths.
claims.reader_assessment: The numerical overlap is visually and tabularly verified within the stated sequence lengths.

figures.caption_original: Attention architecture and perplexity scaling across sequence lengths.
figures.author_interpretation: Proves linear attention feasibility without accuracy loss.
figures.reader_assessment: Confirmed for tested synthetic and language benchmarks.

tables.caption_original: Accuracy comparisons across dense and sparse variants.

assumptions.text: Attention patterns exhibit spatial sparsity in autoregressive generation.

limitations.text: Evaluated primarily on sequences up to 8192 tokens.

open_questions.text: Generalization to bidirectional masking remains uncharacterized.

portable_components.name: Sparse Factorized Attention Kernel
portable_components.io: Tensor [B, S, D] -> Tensor [B, S, D]

argument_chain: Factorized projection reduces token interactions to strided windows.

lens_synthesis.statement: Sparse attention kernel reduces memory footprint while preserving perplexity.
